holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 100 shares at ₹2,025.49 average cost (₹2,02,549.12 total). We already banked ₹1,06,420.08 on the prior 100-share trim. The stake is worth ₹3,11,840.00 on the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger (+53.96%; 7.31% weight, #1 equity slot). On the 2026-11-25 live TV close (₹3,187.50), value is ₹3,18,750.00 (+57.37%). Technically, shares coil in a 7.0% Stage 2 squeeze above the 50-day SMA (₹3,171.07) and 30-week SMA (₹2,848.03). Yet risk-reward is sharply negative. Our reconciled FY28E bridge (₹117.00 Cr D&A, ₹28.16 Cr finance costs, 25.17%–30.0% tax, 4.518 Cr diluted shares) sets Base fair value at ₹2,200.00 (-31.0% vs live; 30%-tax stress ₹2,045.88). Expected value is ₹2,305.00 (-27.7%). Meanwhile, H1 FY27 CFO flipped to -₹20.38 Cr, and short-term debt jumped 7.4x to ₹153.19 Cr after a 100% OFS IPO. Industrial sales fell -21.8% (91.1% Mobility share). On the tape, 8 distribution days and -16.6% 28-day RS weigh on momentum. Expiring 60-day PE block lock-ins (~44–49 lakh prior block = ~42–46x daily volume) add sharp gap-through risk. We sell 50 shares immediately (~₹1,59,375 live TV / ~₹1,55,920 ledger), cutting weight from 7.31% to ~3.66%. We keep 50 core house-money shares behind a ratcheted ₹2,789.41 stop (up +₹92.59 from ₹2,696.82), with a secondary 25-share trim at ₹3,450.00.

primer: SEDEMAC Mechatronics (NSE: SEDEMAC) keeps a Compounder Pass grade on record Q2 volume (1.45M ECUs, +37.5% YoY) and a European OEM win. Yet forensic checks exposed -₹20.38 Cr H1 CFO, a 7.4x jump in short-term debt (₹153.19 Cr), -21.8% Industrial sales, and 19%–22% H1 tax rates. Our reconciled FY28E bridge sets Base fair value at ₹2,200.00 (55.3x EPS ₹39.77; 30%-tax stress ₹2,045.88) and expected value at ₹2,305.00 (-27.7%). At ₹3,187.50 live TV (₹3,118.40 Nov 23 ledger; 109.0x P/E), new capital is REJECTED. On our 100-share Zerodha stake (7.31% wt), we trim 50 shares (~₹1,59,375) to ~3.66% and hold 50 core shares behind a ₹2,789.41 stop.
